title: My Stepdaughter Promised Her Cottage For Treatment, Then Sold It And Blocked Me. So I Own It.
description: After draining my late husband's $200K life insurance for my stepdaughter's experimental cancer treatment, she sold the promised beach cottage and blocked me. I found the signed deed among his files, won a $350K promissory estoppel judgment, and foreclosed. Now I run Gratitude Wave rental where guests read her signature in the betrayal story book. #PromissoryEstoppel #JusticeServed #GratitudeWave
thumb_text: SHE SIGNED IT AWAY, NOW EVERY GUEST READS IT.
pinned_comment: If you drained your late husband's entire $200K life insurance to pay for your stepdaughter's cancer treatment and she then sold the promised cottage and blocked you, what would you do? I'd love to hear your similar stories in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: I DRAINED MY LATE HUSBAND'S $200K POLICY FOR HER CURE
